title: Ukwenqaba Phakathi Kokuchichima
intro: Uzithola uphakathi kwabantu abanezimakethe ezigcwele ukuhweba, kodwa izikali zabo zigobhoza ngokungathembeki. Isithunywa sifikile kubo nezixwayiso ezicacile, kodwa bayahleka futhi bafulathele, beqiniseka ngokuchuma kwabo. Isibhakabhaka siqala ukuba mnyama, kodwa basibona njengesibusiso semvula. Bangobani laba bantu?
clues: Sachuma emazweni ezohwebo kanye nenala, kodwa izinhliziyo zethu zaba lukhuni.
Isithunywa safika kithi nezibonakaliso ezivela eNkosini yethu, kodwa sahleka usulu izixwayiso zayo.
Sasaziwa ngomsebenzi wethu, kodwa sasinciphisa isilinganiso futhi sikhohlisa abantu.
Sasihlala phakathi kwezihlahla eziminyene nezitshalo eziluhlaza, kodwa sazithatha kalula izibusiso zethu.
Lapho ifu elimnyama lisondela, sajabula, sicabanga ukuthi lizoletha imvula ezweni lethu elomile.
Kunalokho, lelo fu lakhipha isijeziso esishisayo, futhi sabanjwa ukuhlushwa kosuku lomthunzi.

trial.answer: Balahla isithunywa sabo futhi bakhohlisa kwezohwebo

verse: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway. (15:79)
